_doc: Declared background regions for magenta keying (source pixel coordinates of the file in source/). Inside a bbox, key-coloured pixels count as background even when enclosed by the object. Used for the sky seen through the gate opening and between the gate bars (owner decision: these must be transparent). Not part of the render manifest.

bg_regions.note: arched gate opening: sky above the gate, gaps between bars, ornament rings; pixels with dE<95 to the key are unmixed (measured: purple bleed dE 30-89, iron/stone dE>=103); despill_all: the iron gate has no legitimate purple, so purple-contaminated thin ornament pixels are despilled
